artist.name: Zoe Wees
artist.short_description: Zoe Wees: an Afterglow editorial discovery candidate in pop.
artist.biography: Zoe Wees is a German singer from Hamburg whose pop songs often feature strong, emotive vocals and elements of contemporary R&B and soul. AllMusic identifies “Control” as an early breakthrough and discusses the releases Golden Wings and Therapy. Her Apple Music catalogue includes “Girls Like Us,” “Hold Me Like You Used To,” “Lightning,” and later singles released in 2025. Her music offers a different vocal texture within Afterglow: the connection is emotional subject matter, but the presentation is often bigger and more dramatic than the softer indie-pop work represented by Sara Kays or Rosie Darling. Several popular appearances are collaborations, including “Learn To Love” with Dean Lewis and “That’s How It Goes” featuring 6LACK. The specific credits must be maintained in any WordPress song record, and exact recording identities should be checked before creating Spotify embeds. Her songs can support collections about vulnerability and emotional resilience, but Afterglow should only attribute an individual song’s precise inspiration to her when an original source documents it.
